tracks.title: 콩이 은퇴식
tracks.mood: mock-solemn, deadpan-comic, strutting; proud affection under the drama
tracks.subject: Told by her handler: at Gimhae Airport the retirement send-off for Kongi, an eight-year-old quarantine detector beagle, goes smoothly until she trots off the podium mid-speech and sits, her trained alert, in front of the director's briefcase, where a snack sausage is hidden.
